results.title: Indian Karting Prodigy Atiqa Mir Shines at FIA World Cup Debut Event
results.description: 11-year-old Indian racing sensation Atiqa Mir impressed at her FIA Karting World Cup debut, finishing as the top female driver and showcasing elite potential with a strong performance against 117 international competitors in the junior category.
